from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,statistics,hashlib,os,time
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'build/excel-conditional-trace-pairs';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
engine=root/'build/memory-call/pcemu';snapshot='/Volumes/data/pcemu/snapshots/excel-dependent-recalc-recovered';task='build/flag-pair/task-120.json'
r={'scope':'Three alternating loaded Excel pairs, same executable and snapshot, FollowJumps versus experimental conditional traces. Headless. Restore separate; process CPU includes control/capture/guest work.','emulatorSha256':hashlib.sha256(engine.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'loadBefore':os.getloadavg(),'startedUnix':time.time(),'pairs':[]}
for n in range(3):
 runs={}
 for mode in (['follow','traces'] if n%2==0 else ['traces','follow']):
  d=out/('pair-'+str(n+1)+'-'+mode)
  cmd=['python3','tools/bench_snapshot_task.py',snapshot,'--task',task,'--repeat','1','--emulator',str(engine),'--restore-timeout','90','--output',str(d),'--jit-traces' if mode=='traces' else '--jit-follow-jumps']
  with (out/(d.name+'.log')).open('w') as f:subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
  runs[mode]=json.load(open(d/'result.json'));print(n+1,mode,runs[mode]['medianTaskResponseMs'],flush=True)
 b=runs['follow']['samples'][0];c=runs['traces']['samples'][0]
 r['pairs'].append({'pair':n+1,'runs':runs,'processCpuRatio':b['processCpuTime']['totalMs']/c['processCpuTime']['totalMs'],'responseRatio':b['taskResponseMs']/c['taskResponseMs'],'executionWallRatio':b['executionWallMs']/c['executionWallMs']})
 (out/'partial.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
for key in ['processCpuRatio','responseRatio','executionWallRatio']:r['medianPaired'+key[0].upper()+key[1:]]=statistics.median(p[key] for p in r['pairs'])
r['loadAfter']=os.getloadavg();r['finishedUnix']=time.time();(out/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print('PASS paired modes',flush=True)
